CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT AGREEMENT (SAMPLE - fictitious, for Certa testing only)
Project: Lekki Duplex Block D
Client: Genius
Contractor: Precious
Contract Sum: N10,000,000.00 (Ten Million Naira)
Payment Schedule
The Client shall pay the Contractor in five (5) stages as follows:
Stage 1 - Mobilisation and site set-up: 10% (N1,000,000.00), due 10 November 2026
Stage 2 - Substructure: 20% (N2,000,000.00), due 1 December 2026
Stage 3 - Ground floor frame and blockwork: 30% (N3,000,000.00), due 15 January 2027
Stage 4 - Roof: 25% (N2,500,000.00), due 15 February 2027
Stage 5 - Finishes and handover: 15% (N1,500,000.00), due 31 March 2027
Retention: 5% of each payment, released after the 6-month defects period.
